chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
'Isa ibn Maryam — may peace be upon our Prophet and his family and upon him — said: 'Woe to the evil scholars! How the Fire blazes upon them!'

key_terms.الْعُلَمَاءُ السَّوْءِ: Evil/corrupt scholars — those with religious knowledge who misuse it
key_terms.تَلَظَّى: To blaze/rage intensely — used in Quran 92:14 of the fiercely raging Fire
key_terms.وَيْلٌ: Woe, destruction — a Quranic exclamation of dire warning

ai.seo_question: What did Jesus (Isa) say about evil scholars according to Imam Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a grave warning attributed to Prophet Jesus (AS): evil and corrupt scholars face a terrifying punishment in the Fire. The hadith belongs to Chapter 15, which deals with the necessity of the divine Proof (Hujja/Imam) for the world and underscores the special responsibility borne by those with religious knowledge. Evil scholars — those who possess knowledge but corrupt it, exploit it, or use it for worldly gain — are here singled out for the severest warning. The early Shia audience would have understood this as a rebuke of scholars who abandoned the true Imam, contrasting with the legitimate 'ulama who transmitted knowledge faithfully.
